toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: 5G/6G non-terrestrial network (NTN) compatibility.
#
# A 5G NTN user terminal can position itself from the downlink of a low Earth orbit (LEO)
# NTN constellation: time of arrival (TOA) from the positioning reference signal, whose
# ranging precision is set by its bandwidth through the Cramer-Rao bound (CRB), and
# Doppler over a pass. The campaign sweeps the reference signal's occupied bandwidth from
# 180 kHz (one narrowband-IoT resource block, as in 5G NR NTN narrowband) to 20 MHz, in
# the S-band mobile-satellite-service (MSS) downlink around 2172.5 MHz, over a generic
# 324-satellite NTN shell at 600 km, and records the CRB range sigma at the zenith and the
# resulting root-mean-square 3D TOA position error.
#
# The range sigma falls as 1/(RMS bandwidth), about 6.5 m at the zenith for 180 kHz and
# 6 cm for 20 MHz; the 3D error falls from about 30 m to about 2 m, where the 1 m network
# synchronisation error (a scenario input) sets the floor.
#
# MODELLED: positioning from Cramer-Rao bounds with a stated synchronisation error; no
# multipath, no 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) waveform detail beyond the
# bandwidth.
kind = "campaign"
title = "NTN positioning against reference-signal bandwidth"
seed = 20260929

[sweep]
metrics = [
  { name = "range_sigma_zenith", path = "signals[0].range_sigma_zenith_m" },
  { name = "toa_rms_error_3d", path = "signals[0].toa_rms_error_3d_m" },
  { name = "toa_availability", path = "signals[0].toa_availability" },
]

[[sweep.axes]]
name = "bandwidth"
key = "signal.0.bandwidth_hz"
unit = "Hz"
start = 180000.0
stop = 20000000.0
steps = 9
scale = "log"

[sweep.scenario]
kind = "ntn-positioning"
seed = 5
carrier_hz = 2172.5e6
integration_s = 0.1
doppler_integration_s = 1.0
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 50.0]
sync_error_m = 1.0
duration_s = 600.0
step_s = 30.0

[sweep.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 52.5
lon_deg = 13.4
height_m = 40.0

[[sweep.scenario.signal]]
name = "NTN positioning reference signal"
bandwidth_hz = 4.5e6

[[sweep.scenario.system]]
name = "NTN shell"
role = "leo"
mask_deg = 10.0

[[sweep.scenario.system.shell]]
total = 324
planes = 18
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 600.0
inclination_deg = 55.0
